description: This file manages Nostr state storage, including reading and writing bus and profile states, handling schema validation, path resolution, and state normalization for a Nostr client implementation.

methods.name: normalizeAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes an account ID by trimming and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: resolveNostrStatePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for storing the Nostr bus state based on account ID and environment.

methods.name: resolveNostrProfileStatePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for storing the Nostr profile state based on account ID and environment.

methods.name: safeParseState
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into NostrBusState, with backward compatibility for v1 schema.

methods.name: readNostrBusState
methods.description: Reads the Nostr bus state from disk, returning null if not found or on error.

methods.name: writeNostrBusState
methods.description: Writes the Nostr bus state to disk, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: computeSinceTimestamp
methods.description: Calculates the 'since' timestamp for subscriptions based on stored state.

methods.name: safeParseProfileState
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into NostrProfileState.

methods.name: readNostrProfileState
methods.description: Reads the Nostr profile state from disk, returning null if not found or on error.

methods.name: writeNostrProfileState
methods.description: Writes the Nostr profile state to disk, creating directories as needed.
